versions.changelog:
- Initial release of evez-api-gateway skill.
- Provides a drop-in, OpenAI-compatible API gateway for EVEZ AI models at significantly lower cost.
- Supports evez-smart, evez-code, evez-fast, and evez-vision models.
- Offers generous free tier (100K tokens/month) and affordable Pro/Business plans.
- Includes features such as streaming support, API key management, and usage tracking.
